svg.title: 図05 ARD method
svg.desc: Blueprint of ARD on SVTRv2. Deployed path, solid: crop, a ~40k-parameter router choosing one of four MSR buckets, SVTRv2 backbone with FRM, CTC head, text. Training only, dashed: the crop is rendered on two canvases, per-character CTC loss decides which reads better, and a Bradley-Terry preference loss trains the router; SGM's left and right streams form a soft teacher distilled into the CTC head at aligned timesteps (uniform or Viterbi) with KL plus cross-entropy.
svg.text: solid: what ships (ctc only) · dashed: training only, never exported
ships: router + the unchanged ctc model · no extra decoder
K = 4 buckets · β = 0.2 · exploration ≈ 1–2% step time · 49 tests, 17 for ard
status: implemented and tested; benchmark runs pending, so no accuracy claims yet
